COVID-19 & now HMPV? 🚨
New pandemic on the brink from China? Think again! This metapneumovirus has been lurking in India for decades, causing ACI in kids. A study at AIIMS exposed its surprising prevalence at just 3% of nasopharyngeal swabs.
#hmpvvirus #HMPVoutbreak #MedTwitter https://t.co/OGCvx1udkb
